key_insight: XStack benchmarks AI agents on migrating entire ML repositories from PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs to JAX on Google TPUs, revealing that reliable migration remains difficult.
engineering_relevance: Cross-framework and cross-hardware migration could give researchers more freedom to choose compute infrastructure without rewriting repositories manually.
method: Give each agent a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine.
Require a working JAX repository as the migration output.
Grade outputs against criteria based on source repositories’ published results, authenticated and calibrated by the authors.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports pass rates of 75% for Claude Opus 5, 45% for GPT-5.6-sol, and at most 40% for every other evaluated agent.
watch_item: The abstract evaluates PyTorch-to-JAX migration only and does not report benchmark size or execution budgets, limiting broader reliability conclusions.
paper_title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
